resources.string: Could not open phone Settings. Open Settings manually and find Developer options to check the three switches. A hidden page does not verify that debugging is off.

Manual checks: in phone Settings, find Developer options. Turn off Wireless debugging and USB debugging, then Developer options. Check all three switches. A hidden page does not verify that debugging is off.

For a future desktop session, set up Shizuku deliberately. If Developer options is hidden, open About phone and repeatedly tap Build number or the manufacturer\'s version entry. This enables Developer options. The path varies by phone; see User guide for a Xiaomi example. Then open Developer options and follow Shizuku setup. DexDroid never re-enables these switches automatically. This is not a step for turning debugging off.
